integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible finite diagnostics included; prior literature comparison has an inaccessible relevant historical full text. Absolute novelty is not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for two-zone, transparent-interface, one-dimensional independent run-and-reverse particle and spatial arithmetic-mean constraints. General velocity-jump homogenization predates this result. No bounded-amplitude physical implementation theorem.
title: Sharp diffusion gain from localized direction reversals in two-zone run-and-reverse motion
